verdicts.reason: A: a clean split banner. The logo sits in the dark brand panel and the copy is stacked in one centred column. The flaws are that the right column is tightly packed, with little space between the divider, body copy, CTA and legal text, and the legal text is barely readable. It also stacks vertically when a banner should read left to right. B: the reading order is broken. The eyebrow 'Limited Summer Release' is oversized, sits at the bottom left under the logo and competes with the headline. The orange divider is stranded above it, away from the headline. The dark logo panel floats with uneven margins, and the legal text is crammed into an illegibly tiny block under the CTA.
